data.name: Nasikh
data.long_meaning: A person who gives instructions or leads, from the Arabic root ‘n-s-kh’ meaning to lead, guide, or instruct. In Islamic history, the title 'Nasikh al-Millah' refers to a leader or ruler of the Muslim community who upholds and enforces the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of guidance and wisdom, leading others on the path to righteousness.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with the name Nasikh are natural leaders, with a strong sense of responsibility and a drive to succeed. They are compassionate and understanding, making them well-suited to roles of care and guidance.
